programme.desc: Alex est averti de la fugue de deux jeunes garçons de 12 et 10 ans, partis avec un pistolet volé à leur père, un militaire fraîchement rentré du Mali. Apparemment, les parents des petits fugueurs se disputent souvent violemment. Pour Alex, cette histoire a une résonance particulière : savoir ces deux garçons seuls dans la nature, avec une arme à feu dont ils ne mesurent pas la dangerosité, lui est insupportable et monopolise toute son attention. Le lendemain, le cadavre d'une jeune femme assassinée d'une balle en plein coeur remonte à la surface d'un lac dans une vallée voisine.

programme.title: La p'tite librairie
programme.sub-title: Les nuits de Paris, de Restif de La Bretonne
programme.desc: Parce que la lecture est et restera l'un des meilleurs moyens de toujours s'évader, François Busnel invite les téléspectateurs à pénétrer dans "La P'tite Librairie". Sur les étagères, on y trouve des romans, des essais, de grands classiques ou des bandes dessinées. En bref, des livres à dévorer sans modération pour faire voyager l'esprit depuis son canapé. François Busnel propose chaque jour de découvrir ou redécouvrir une oeuvre française ou étrangère : roman, essai, grand classique ou encore bande dessinée. Bref, il s'agit là d'une bonne occasion de se mettre à la page.

programme.title: Le jeu des 1000 euros
programme.desc: Le jeu grand public et intergénérationnel de France Inter arrive à la télévision. Cette nouvelle version sera l'occasion de découvrir en plateau les meilleurs candidats issus de l'émission radio et venus de toutes les régions de France. Chaque semaine Nicolas Stoufflet et Carinne Teyssandier départageront 10 binômes, dont un seul sera sacré champion du "Jeu des 1000 Euros".

programme.title: Questions pour un champion
programme.desc: Samuel Etienne anime ce célèbre jeu emblématique, qui voit chaque soir s'affronter quatre candidats autour de questions de culture générale.

programme.desc: Programme Court Parrainé avec FTP Annonceur GMF Production VML.

programme.title: Le pitch cinéma
programme.desc: Chaque semaine Le Pitch Cinéma vous présente 5 sorties de la semaine. Rythmé et graphique, une mystérieuse silhouette en contre jour devant un grand écran " donne les clefs aux téléspectateurs pour se forger leur opinion " et décider ensuite d'aller voir les films… ou pas ! Le Pitch Cinéma fait appel à la culture cinématographique des téléspectateurs et propose pour chaque sortie de film un véritable jeu d'association : si vous avez aimé tel film, vous risquez d'aimer tel film….

programme.title: C'est bon à savoir
programme.sub-title: Aller voir un diététicien-nutritionniste. A quoi ça sert ?
programme.desc: "C'est bon à savoir" décrypte les bénéfices pour la santé de la consommation des fruits et légumes et analyse leur mode de culture, sans oublier de parler d'environnement. Avec la complicité d'experts, ce programme revient quelques idées reçues.

programme.title: Météo régionale
programme.desc: Un bulletin météorologique propre à chaque région.

programme.title: Dans le rétro
programme.desc: "Dans le rétro" propose un voyage dans le temps de trois minutes, grâce aux archives de l'INA.

programme.title: Stade 2
programme.desc: Chaque fin de semaine, Stade 2 propose de retrouver les résultats des derniers événements sportifs, mais aussi des portraits, des grands reportages, des interviews en plateau ou en duplex et des enquêtes. Au programme : du football, du rugby, du tennis, du cyclisme, des sports mécaniques, et bien d'autres disciplines.

programme.title: Saint-Pierre
programme.desc: Le corps décapité d'Alphonse Nova, un milliardaire, est retrouvé. Le malheureux a eu la tête tranchée par une guillotine exposée dans le musée de Saint-Pierre. Fait étonnant : son corps ne présente aucune trace de lutte. Fitz et Arch découvrent que, la veille de son meurtre, Alphonse avait eu une dispute violente avec son fils, Lucius. Celui-ci venait de découvrir que son père avait retiré tout l'argent qu'il avait investi dans l'entreprise qu'il venait de lancer.

programme.title: Saint-Pierre
programme.desc: Le sergent Quint Boone, qui n'est pas un inconnu pour Fitz, débarque à Saint-Pierre. Il traque Donna Masters, une braqueuse qui vient de s'échapper de prison et qu'il soupçonne d'avoir trouvé refuge sur l'île grâce à de faux papiers. Arch est rapidement intriguée par la relation d'animosité et de méfiance entre les deux policiers. Les enquêteurs s'intéressent à Gerard Bennett, un commerçant qui a déjà eu des soucis avec la loi pour avoir fabriqué de fausses pièces d'identité. Cette piste ne semble mener à rien.

programme.title: Commissaire Dupin
programme.desc: Lors d'une escapade dominicale dans la forêt de Brocéliande, le commissaire Dupin manque de renverser une jeune femme qui vient de trouver le cadavre de son mari, Fabien Cadiou. Quelques instants plus tard, un deuxième corps, celui d'un dénommé Paul Picard, est retrouvé non loin de là, et Dupin apprend que les deux hommes étaient amis. Picard s'était introduit chez Cadiou pour commettre un cambriolage, avant d'être lui-même tué à son tour. Qu'était-il venu chercher chez son ami ?

programme.title: Les enquêtes de Vera
programme.desc: Après le départ d'Aiden pour l'Australie, Joe Ashworth reprend son poste auprès de Vera. Tous deux sont appelés sur une route de campagne tranquille où un jeune homme a été retrouvé mort après une collision avec une voiture dont le chauffeur a pris la fuite. En y regardant de plus près, Vera comprend qu'il ne s'agit pas d'un accident. La victime était un commerçant populaire sur le marché. Pour en savoir plus, Vera se rend sur son emplacement. Elle espère ainsi découvrir qui il était, et pourquoi quelqu'un désirait si ardemment sa mort.

programme.title: Les enquêtes de Vera
programme.desc: Lizzy Swann, enseignante et mère de famille apparemment sans histoires, a été retrouvée morte au pied d'une promenade côtière aménagée à flanc de falaise. Peu de temps auparavant, Lizzy avait été mise à pied de l'école où elle travaillait, à la suite d'un signalement abusif qu'elle avait fait auprès des services sociaux. Vera et son équipe s'intéressent alors au père de l'enfant concerné, mais également au mari de la victime, à un vieil ami de la famille, et au petit ami de sa fille cadette.

programme.title: Harmonie de Noël
programme.desc: Harmony est fiancée à un célèbre chanteur. Quand ce dernier la quitte peu avant Noël, la jeune femme, effondrée, décide de retourner auprès de sa famille dans sa petite ville natale. Elle retrouve de vieux amis, se rapproche de son père qu'elle n'avait pas vu depuis des années et renoue avec la musique, sa vraie passion.

programme.title: Herlige Hjem
programme.desc: For et år siden flyttet småbarnsfamilien Erlandsen inn i ærverdige Villa Frednes, en herskapsvilla i Porsgrunn sentrum fra 1905 oppført i stilarten ny-renessanse. De fikk villaen på 1400 kvm for en billig penge mot at de pusset opp det staselige bygget. I den gamle vaktemesterboligen på Hovedøya i Oslo flyttet Anders og Rudolf inn for fem år siden, og ble de eneste fastboende på øya. Med klosterruinene vegg i vegg, har de skapt et idyllisk hjem som blander moderne design med herskapelig stil.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Etterforskningen leder Bob og John til Nord-Spania. Mye tyder på at Hitler kom hit etter Danmark, og James Holland og Mike Simpson blir sendt for å undersøke. I San Sebastian finner de flere øyevitner, en satelitt etter det tredje riket, og noe som kan være et Nazi kommunikasjonssenter. I Misiones, Argentina, får teamet kontakt med en slektning av Herman Göring, samt et øyevitne som hevder at faren jobbet for Martin Bormann, Hitlers høyre hånd, som også ble erklært død i 1945.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: Har det amerikanske militæret hentet ny teknologi, som stealth-teknologi, fra ufoer de har funnet?

programme.title: Lethally Blonde
programme.desc: En danser forsvinner, og overkroppen hennes skylles i land. Politiet må jakte på en morder i New Orleans' mørke og farlige underverden.

programme.title: Toxic
programme.desc: Det starter som et kjærlig ekteskap, men utvikler seg til falske anklager, en brutal kamp om foreldrerett og et tap Rod McCall aldri kunne tenkt seg.

programme.title: Toxic: What Happened In The Haight House?
programme.desc: Familien Haight er tilsynelatende perfekt, men bak lukkede dører foregår mishandling som utvikler seg til noe helt utenkelig.

programme.title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders
programme.desc: Derricka er selfmade millionær og en sterk forretningskvinne. Når ambisiøse Ashley ber Derricka om å bli mentoren hennes, lærer hun en tøff lekse.

programme.title: Deadly Influence: The Social Media Murders
programme.desc: TikTok-dansestjernen Matima og klesdesigneren Quinton drømmer om et bedre liv for familiene sine, men en sjalu følger truer ambisjonene deres.

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: Mike Snyder starter en familie med sin partner, og dokumenterer alt med hjemmevideoer. Men etter å ha blitt diagnostisert med en alvorlig sykdom, forsvinner han. Hva har skjedd?

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: I California trenger noen seg inn i hjemmet til Joan Dawley og dreper henne. Hemmelige hjemmevideoer avslører en sjokkerende historie om svik og et monster som ventet i kulissene.

programme.title: Stranger Among Us
programme.desc: Tre medlemmer i et sammensveiset samfunn blir skutt og drept, og de lokale vil ha svar. Men det kan vise seg at morderen har levd blant dem.

programme.title: Stranger Among Us
programme.desc: En sammensveiset gjeng med brannmenn i West Virginia får sjokk da de oppdager at en mistenkelig brann viser seg å skjule et trippelmord.

programme.title: Highway To Hell
programme.desc: Et ektepar kjører til Ohio på jakt etter drømmehjemmet. Men etter bare en time får et tilsynelatende tilfeldig overfall tragiske følger.

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: Det blir funnet to lik etter en bilulykke, og etterforskerne avdekker den nifse sannheten om et tilsynelatende perfekt parforhold.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Etter at Leahs foreldre dør, drar hun på en sjelegranskende reise. Men når bilen hennes blir funnet vraket og forlatt i en nasjonalpark, blir politi og familie forvirret.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Når statsadvokat Ray Gricar ikker kommer tilbake fra en kort kjøretur på landet, prøver etterforskerne å finne spor som kan forklare hans forsvinning.

programme.title: I'd Kill for You
programme.desc: Kampen om foreldreretten truer med å ødelegge livene til familien Carpenter. Når datteren, en stjerneadvokat, blir involvert, fører det til sex og bedrageri.

programme.title: I'd Kill for You
programme.desc: Hvor langt vil du gå for den du elsker? Dette programmet tar for seg utrolige forbrytelser hvor kjærlighet eller hengivenhet prioriteres over et menneskes liv.

programme.title: Living A Nightmare
programme.desc: En 23-år gammel mann blir savnet i det lille samfunnet Beech Island i Sør-Carolina. Mens familien leter etter ham, dukker det opp en illevarslende tekstmelding som øker mysteriet.

programme.title: Living A Nightmare
programme.desc: En 20 år gammel student i Ohio blir savnet etter at hun syklet hjem fra kjærestens hus. Etterforskerne begynner en hektisk jakt for å finne henne.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Canadiske Elizabeth Roxanne Haysom og hennes tidligere kjæreste, Jens Söring, sto bak dobbeltdrapet på hennes foreldre Derek og Nancy Haysom i 1985.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Politiet finner Genores forslåtte lik etter at hun blir meldt savnet. Men ingen fiender kan finnes, og de forstår ikke hvem som kan ha elsket henne til døde.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: Steve og Amy besøker en skrekkslagen kvinne i California som hevder hjemmet hennes angripes av det overnaturlige. Hun tror en ånd drepte romkameraten.

programme.title: Jack Osbourne's Night Of Terror
programme.desc: Jack og Kelly Osbourne reiser til hjemsøkte Virginia City i Nevada. Der tar de for seg Piper's Opera House og Washoe Club, to steder med mye overnaturlig aktivitet.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: Teamet drar til Georgia for å undersøke åstedet for en tragisk togulykke i 1900. Kan lokomotivet ha vært under en forbannelse, eller er det en ukjent kraft på ferde i byen?

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: Teamet drar til Manchac Swamp i Louisiana, som ryktes å være et paranormalt område. De er det første teamet til å undersøke åstedet for USAs største slaveopprør.

programme.title: Jack Osbourne's Night Of Terror
programme.desc: Jack og Kelly Osbourne reiser til hjemsøkte Virginia City i Nevada. Der tar de for seg Piper's Opera House og Washoe Club, to steder med mye overnaturlig aktivitet.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse Of Power
programme.sub-title: I Deserve To Live, They Don't
programme.desc: Millionærdirektøren Kim Bailey mistenker at de ansatte stjeler fra henne. Når en kollega forsvinner, får FBIs etterforskning en dødelig utgang.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse Of Power
programme.desc: Når en legekommisjon fratar smertelegen Randeep Mann lisensen på grunn av beskyldninger om praksisen hans, legger han en plan for å få tilbake makten.

programme.title: Disappeared
programme.desc: Etter at Leahs foreldre dør, drar hun på en sjelegranskende reise. Men når bilen hennes blir funnet vraket og forlatt i en nasjonalpark, blir politi og familie forvirret.

programme.title: Deadly Affairs
programme.desc: McGuire-paret har alt: vellykkede karrierer og en voksende familie. Men når en av dem har en affære på arbeidsplassen, faller det tidligere så perfekte ekteskapet sammen.

programme.title: Deadly Affairs
programme.desc: Et par i Michigan starter en tegneseriebutikk og ansetter en ukjent person som endrer ekteskapet deres for alltid. I Texas truer en ny medarbeider ekteskapets ukrenkelighet.

programme.title: American Detective With Lt. Joe Kenda
programme.desc: Noen seilere oppdager restene av en 16-årig jente fem kilometer utenfor kysten av Jersey. Et uventet spor leder etterforskerne til å avsløre morderens kaldblodige sammensvergelse.

programme.title: American Detective With Lt. Joe Kenda
programme.desc: En ung kvinne blir brutalt myrdet bare noen skritt fra en beryktet leir for hjemløse. Etterforskerne starter jakten på en fordervet seriemorder.

programme.title: Grave Mysteries
programme.desc: I 2009 forsvant en kvinne og etterlot seg en melding på sosiale medier om at hun dro sin vei. Men familie og venner tror ikke på at hun ville forlatt barna sine.

programme.title: Grave Mysteries
programme.desc: Liket av gravide Tiffinie Adams blir funnet på en åker i en liten by. Politiet bruker hennes sosiale medier til å avsløre morderen.

programme.title: Breaking Homicide
programme.desc: I 2013 ble 22-åringen Amber Bass skutt og drept i oppkjørselen sin etter en natt på byen. Var det tilfeldig vold eller var en sjalu elsker involvert?

programme.title: Breaking Homicide
programme.desc: Da Sharon Robinsons lik ble funnet utenfor New Orleans, ble hennes voldelige kjæreste, en korrupt politimann, mistenkt. Men var hun involvert noe verre?

programme.title: I Almost Got Away With It
programme.sub-title: Got to Pose as a War Vet
programme.desc: Han spiller krigsveteran og utnytter kvinner for å skaffe seg penger, biler og til og med et hus. Jerrod Durr er i en katt-og-mus-lek med politiet gjennom flere delstater.

programme.title: I Almost Got Away With It
programme.desc: Som 17-åring dømmes Randy Baggett til livsvarig fengsel etter å ha kvalt sin voldelige stefar. Med tiden rømmer han fra fengselet to ganger.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving A Serial Killer
programme.desc: På 1960-tallet ble Morgan Rowan overfalt av Rodney Alcala. 50 år senere får Morgan vite at hun ikke er den eneste som har overlevd angrepene hans.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving A Serial Killer
programme.desc: I 1981 voldtar og skyter to menn en ung mor og tvinger forloveden hennes til å se på. Det skal ta tjue år før rettferdigheten seirer.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.sub-title: She Should Be Left To Die
programme.desc: Da politiet forteller en mann at kjæresten hans har tilstått nekter han å tro det - fordi det vil være det samme som å tilstå at han var blind for de grusomme tingene hun gjorde.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here
programme.desc: Steven Crittenden avslører sjokkerende nyheter for sin bror. Nå må Bryant avgjøre om han skal svikte familien sin eller la en morder gå fri.

programme.title: Toxic
programme.desc: Det starter som et kjærlig ekteskap, men utvikler seg til falske anklager, en brutal kamp om foreldrerett og et tap Rod McCall aldri kunne tenkt seg.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: Dette er den utrolige historien om en tresort som har eksistert i 800 år, tåler selv de tøffeste forhold og er mer populært blant insekter, fugler og dyr enn noe annet – det enorme apebrødtreet som lever på savannen i Malilangwe viltreservat i det sørlige Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Tusker: Elefantenes brorskap
programme.desc: Få et innblikk i verdens største biomassevandring, den årlige, 1600 kilometer lange sardinvandringen langs østkysten av Sør-Afrika. Se milliarder av disse bittesmå fiskene svømme slalåm mellom sultne rovdyr som listige seler og stupende havsuler.

programme.title: Min beste venn er et dyr
programme.desc: Sjekk at dovendyret Elsa har det bra med Pedro, som har viet livet sitt til å ta vare på henne etter at hun ble lam. Få vite hvorfor ulven Thor har mennesket Steve i flokken, og se Kristen og Beau gjøre livet enklere for vaskebjørnen Crystal.

programme.title: Min beste venn er et dyr
programme.desc: Lær å svømme med oteren Ozzy og treneren Leslie, og se hvordan Petronel har fått det foreldreløse neshornet Riris tillit etter å ha blitt traumatisert av krypskyttere. Snus deg frem til landminer med rotta Kobe, og fridykk med hammerhaien Gaia.

programme.title: En bies dagbok
programme.desc: I en bikube jobber titusenvis av små dyr sammen mot et felles mål: koloniens overlevelse. Men hvordan er livet for en enkelt honningbie? En bies dagbok forteller deg den historien.

programme.title: Månens ville side
programme.desc: Dra ut på episke reiser styrt av månens kraft. Se hvordan usynlige signaler styrer hvaler og skilpadders migrasjonsruter i havet, fly på tvers av kontinenter med nattravner, og se kompostbiller og andre insekter navigere ved hjelp av måneskinnet.

programme.title: Kimberley - Australias ville vestkyst
programme.desc: Unngå skjelldekte og fjærkledde farer med wallabyer, se krageagamer kjempe om maker, og bli med på etegilde med nyklekkede krokodiller. Utforsk farlige stryk og forstår den kulturelle og biologiske viktigheten av en lokal elv i regnsesongen.

programme.title: Kampen om herredømme
programme.desc: Savannen i Afrika er et fantastisk landskap, og uansett om det dreier seg om stangende flodhester, hormonelle elefanter eller duellerende løver, er slagene som utspiller seg på savannen, like fantastiske.

programme.title: Kenyas villmarkshistorier
programme.desc: Lewa Conservancy arbeider for å føre elefanter tilbake til området fra Mt. Kenya til Samburu nasjonalpark. De har også opprettet en avsperret sone for elefanter for å forsøke å gjenoppbygge et skadet økosystem. Sporingshalsbånd brukes i begge tilfeller for å hjelpe naturvernerne med å forstå elefantens behov bedre, og for å se om de vender tilbake til de naturlige korridorene.

programme.title: Ukjente landskap
programme.desc: Lær om verdens største vulkanske øy, et ensomt og forrevent sted der damp slippes ut, vann eksploderer og nytt terreng dannes hver dag. Se hvordan ild og is møtes i et slag som gjør dette til den mest geologisk kraftfulle øya i verden.

programme.title: Ukjente landskap
programme.desc: Bli med på en reise på en øy bygget av vulkaner, men formet av is. For ca. 1,5 millioner år siden kom et islag nordfra og la seg over landskapet. I dag fortsetter enorme isbreer å skjære ut klipper og file ned fjell.

programme.title: Ukjente landskap
programme.desc: Bli med til det brusende havet i Fundybukta og finn ut hvordan dette økosystemet på østkysten av Canada livnærer en rekke skapninger, deriblant hundretusenvis av sjøfugler, verdens raskeste rovdyr og et innviklet nett av virvelløse dyr.

programme.title: Ukjente landskap
programme.desc: Bli med langs vestkysten av Storbritannia, der verdens lengste ubrutte gangsti strekker seg gjennom over 1200 kilometer med storslått landskap. Denne majestetiske kysten yrer av ville dyr, geologiske mysterier og mange hundre år med menneskenes historie.

programme.title: Ukjente landskap
programme.desc: Bli kjent med en øy som er omgitt av det mektige Atlanterhavet, prisgitt knusende bølger og kraftig regn. Fra Cliffs of Moher til Giant's Causeway har dette landet blitt formet og omformet av vann og voldsomme geologiske krefter.

programme.title: Ukjente landskap
programme.desc: Bli med til den ville stillehavskysten på vestsiden av Vancouver Island i British Columbia. Naturen og menneskene eksisterer side ved side i spektakulære habitater, fra isbreer i fjellene til tretoppene i Canadas eneste regnskog.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: På tvers av bølgete sanddyner, i de vindblåste gressområdene i den sørlige Kalahari tårner et praktfullt kameltre. Den har stått her i to århundrer. Dette treet er aldri ensomt, lær hvordan det gir mat, ly og et jaktterreng til mange skapninger.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: Oppdag historien om det høyt elskede pølsetreet, hvis nektarfylte blomster og pølseformede frukter lokker dyr av alle slag, fra insekter til elefanter. Se hvordan dyrene som stoler på dette sjenerøse treet sikrer spredningen.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: I en tåkete sørafrikansk skog vokser et seks hundre år gammelt Outeniqua tre. Med sine førti meter ruver hun høyt over over kalesjen og er en av de få som er igjen av sitt slag. Følg hennes fengslende historie, like unik som økosystemet i grenene hennes.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: Namaqua-bergfikentreet lever i skråningen på en steinete høyde i Manaqualand i Sør-Afrika. Det er den ultimate overlevende som tåler de ugjestmilde forholdene i et landskap som hvert år opplever stadig stigende temperaturer og mindre og mindre regn.

programme.title: Røtter
programme.desc: Dette er den utrolige historien om en tresort som har eksistert i 800 år, tåler selv de tøffeste forhold og er mer populært blant insekter, fugler og dyr enn noe annet – det enorme apebrødtreet som lever på savannen i Malilangwe viltreservat i det sørlige Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Sjefshai
programme.desc: Se den ultimate kampen for dominans mens vitenskapsmenn prøver å identifisere alfahannen i en flokk på over 100 hvithaier ved kysten av New Zealand. Bli imponert av hastigheten, jaktferdighetene og fryktløsheten som avgjør hvem som skal lede flokken.

programme.title: Superhaienes hovedvei
programme.desc: Dra ut på et farlig merkingsoppdrag i Sør-Australia som viser hva haier spiser og hvorfor de samles på matplasser. Sett så kursen nordover når teamet prøver å finner tiger-, okse- og hammerhaier og utstyrer en av dem med et 360-graders ryggkamera.

programme.title: Superhaienes hovedvei
programme.desc: Følg en gravid hai langs Great Barrier Reef og se om hun bringer forskningsteamet til sin hemmelige fødeplass. Se etter tegn på parring langs sørkysten, som kan avsløre en veldig sjenert megahai-hunn på jakt etter en partner.

programme.title: Superhaienes hovedvei
programme.desc: Vær våken til langt på natt når teamet i nord fester en aktivitetsmåler på en oksehai og finner ut hva denne nattugla gjør etter solnedgang. Dykk ned til 80 meter med teamet i sør, som håper å feste en satellitt-tracker på en hvithai-hunn.

programme.title: Superhaienes hovedvei
programme.desc: La deg forundre av hierarkiet i haisamfunn når det nordre teamet ser på unge svartstripehaier som lærer sosiale regler og overlevelse. Ved Rainbow Beach er det sørlige teamet ivrige på å bevitne sandtigerhaien best skjulte adferd: parring.

programme.title: Superhaienes hovedvei
programme.desc: Reis til enden av Australias haimotorvei. Finn ut om Greenly Island i sør er en rasteplass for migrerende hvithaier, og se etter bevis på en genetisk sammenheng mellom nordlige oksehaier og deres søskenbarn i kjøligere områder.

programme.title: Superhaienes hovedvei
programme.sub-title: Forsiktig, det er mennesker der oppe!
programme.desc: Følg det sørlige teamet når de tester ny migrasjonsteknologi og verktøy som kan redusere haiangrep i et populært snorkleområde. Bli med på å fange og merke oksehaier med det nordlige teamet, som vil hjelpe svømmere med å unngå fødende mødre.

programme.title: Kampen om herredømme
programme.desc: Velkommen til India, et land fullt av eksotiske dyr og eksotisk krigføring. Aper havner i støvete slagsmål, hjorteantiloper går til krig på de åpne slettene, og påfugler slåss med springkniver. Disse fargerike kampene er et fargerikt land verdig.

programme.title: Kenyas villmarkshistorier
programme.desc: Elefantjakt har vært forbudt i Kenya i 40 år, men organiserte gjenger med krypskyttere jakter fortsatt ulovlig på elefanter og selger støttennene på svartebørsen. Naturvernere og miljøaktivister slår alarm.

programme.title: Tidevannets rike
programme.desc: Lavvannet blottlegger en kyststripe som kalles tidevannssonen. Her finnes det utrolige ytterpunkter som angripes av bølger med en orkans styrke og utsettes for stekende hete. Dyrene her har utviklet seg på utallige merkelige måter. Forskere ser nærmere på dette fremmede riket.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Der fjellene krysser internasjonale grenser, lever flokker av wapiti og elg side om side med rovdyr som bjørn og ulv. Forholdet mellom rovdyr og byttedyr er en skjør balansegang, og det perfekte stedet å se det utarte seg, er området Kootenay i Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Luften er tynn og kald, og selv ikke trær kan leve her. Det er ikke akkurat et gjestmildt sted å bo. Men dyr som fjellgeit og tykkhornsau, og til og med svartbjørn, beveger seg rundt på toppene uten problemer. Vi ser nærmere på hvordan disse dyrene klarer å utfordre tyngdekraften blant noen av de høyeste fjelltoppene på kontinentet.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Noen av de største elvene i Nord-Amerika har sitt utspring i isbreene i Rocky Mountains. Innsjøene, elvene og myrene i Rockies er som pulsårer som går gjennom landskapet og gir næring til alle dyrene som holder til i fjellene. Disse vannveiene drives av tyngdekraften og deles opp av de enorme fjellene, som leder vannet ut i Atlanterhavet, Stillehavet og Nordishavet. Fra de ubeboelige, islagte fjelltoppene smelter vannet fra isbreene, renner ned drønnende fossefall, snor seg gjennom våtmarker og former terrenget før det omsider renner ut i havet. På veien gir det næring til både planter og dyr og forandrer omgivelsene.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: Skal man overleve i skogen, må man opprettholde den skjøre balansen mellom vekst og ødeleggelse og død og fødsel – en skog bør være i konstant fornyelse. Hvis trærne blir for høye, hindrer de alt sollyset i å treffe bakken. Det betyr at gress og mindre busker ikke kan vokse, og habitatet for dyr som wapiti, elg, karibu og ulver blir mindre.

programme.title: Wild Rockies
programme.desc: For mange arter er strukturen i grupper det viktigste for å overleve. Selv om sosiale levesett er nødvendig for mange av dyrene som lever i Rocky Mountains, er det ingen arter som organiserer samfunnet på samme måte. Selv blant arter som er nært i slekt, kan det være store forskjeller i den sosiale strukturen. Kommunikasjon, hierarki, paring og diett styres alle av bestemte miljømessige og genetiske tilpasninger for at gruppen skal overleve.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: I Luangwadalen i Zambia lever Afrikas største og mest fryktinngytende kjemper, men det som virkelig gjør dalen spesiell, er fuglene. Det finnes over 400 ulike fuglearter her, og alle er perfekt tilpasset for å utnytte alle mulighetene som finnes.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: Afrika er et kontinent fullt av unike og fantastiske dyr med en tilværelse som har utviklet seg gjennom millioner av år. Afrika er også menneskenes fødested. Vi reiste sammen med dyrene på kontinentet i vår egen evolusjonsreise, men intelligensen tok oss i en annen retning. Nysgjerrigheten vår førte til spørsmål om verden rundt oss, som ble besvart gjennom fortellinger, myter og legender.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: Elefanten Chilema har bare en halv snabel etter at hun mistet enden på snabelen i en krypskytterfelle som var satt opp for antiloper. Men fellen skiller ikke mellom dyr, noe som betyr at andre dyr enn de fellen var ment for, ofte blir fanget i dem – med katastrofale følger. Nå må Chilema tilpasse seg livet uten det viktigste verktøyet til elefanten. Hun må lære seg å spise, drikke og bade for å klare seg. Når hun i tillegg må hanskes med den tøffe tørketiden, kjemper hun for å overleve mot alle odds.

programme.title: Historier fra Zambia
programme.desc: Trærne er Afrikas eldste beboere, og hver av dem har sin egen strategi for å overleve tørketiden. Pølsetreet og fikentreet holder ut årstidenes ekstreme forhold for å gi dyrene mat og ly i magre tider. Til gjengjeld hjelper dyrene disse trærne med å formere seg ved å bestøve blomstene deres og spre frøene. Afrikanske trær fremmer liv og er ryggraden i et av de mest verdifulle økosystemene i verden.

programme.title: Tusker: Elefantenes brorskap
programme.desc: Få et innblikk i verdens største biomassevandring, den årlige, 1600 kilometer lange sardinvandringen langs østkysten av Sør-Afrika. Se milliarder av disse bittesmå fiskene svømme slalåm mellom sultne rovdyr som listige seler og stupende havsuler.

programme.title: Sjefshai
programme.desc: Vær vitne til en annerledes haikonkurranse, der hvithaier stilles mot hverandre i en utrolig styrketest. Sett alt på spill med haispesialist Dr. Riley Elliott når han prøver å finne svar på et eldgammelt spørsmål: Hvilket kjønn er det beste?

programme.title: Hemmelighetene i det magiske vannet
programme.desc: Dykk ned i havets mørkeste dyp for å se havets mest mystiske beboere. Reis på tvers av vidstrakt, åpent hav med knølhvaler, og ta en spasertur på havbunnen og vær vitne til storslått bioluminescens.

programme.title: Hemmelighetene i det magiske vannet
programme.desc: Reis langs Jordens kyst, der kolliderende verdener skaper en smeltedigel av biodiversitet. Se spekkhoggere som jakter med presisjon, hold deg fast når lomvier kaster seg ut, kryp i sikkerhet med nyklekkede skilpadder, og se krabber lage sandgalakser.

programme.title: Hemmelighetene i det magiske vannet
programme.desc: Følg flotte vannveier verden over, fra vulkanske elver i det østlige Russland til geotermiske elver i Florida. Se hvordan bevere endrer landskapet med sine flott utformede demninger, og nyt en vinterspadag sammen med manater.

programme.title: Hemmelighetene i det magiske vannet
programme.desc: Reis gjennom mystiske innsjøer der livet tilpasser seg, overlever og endres. Vær vitne til kraften hos oldtidsbeist som snappeskilpadder, se en øyenstikkers metamorfose, og vandre høyreist blant flamingoer i det brennende, etsende vannet.

programme.title: Hemmelighetene i det magiske vannet
programme.desc: Avdekk dem sære skjønnheten til sumpene, som har inspirert folketro i århundrer, og vært en vital forbindelse mellom liv og død. Svøm med sultne krokodiller, se rådyr sette livet på spill for mat og se kjøttetende planter fange bytter.

programme.title: Hemmelighetene i det magiske vannet
programme.desc: Frys tiden når vann blir en kilde til endring i Jordens kaldeste økosystemer. Jakt på intetanende seler med isbjørnene, bad i naturlige varme kilder med makakene, og prøv en unik overlevelsesstrategi med polarrevene.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Ludwig Wicki leads the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and the DR Junior Choir in a sparkling concert program of film music. The program features a selection of music from great and Oscar-winning Hollywood films, including Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart, and Moulin Rouge, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner, and Klaus Badelt. Highlights include ‘He’s a pirate/Davy Jones’ from Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man’s Chest; ‘Now We Are Free’ from Gladiator; ‘My Heart Will Go On’ from Titanic; and ‘Shallow’ from A Star Is Born. Featured soloists in this concert are the young talented singers Andrea Lykke Oehlenschlæger and Diluckshan Jeyaratnam. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2022.

programme.title: Die großen Musikrivalen
programme.desc: Two men without whom the profession of conductor would not be what it is today. Two men who couldn't be more different from each other: Arturo Toscanini and Wilhelm Furtwängler. The former was rigorously faithful to the musical score, the latter conducted with radical subjectivity. In 1931 they both conducted at the Bayreuth Festival – for the first and last time. programme.title: Madeleine Peyroux at Bordeaux's Grand-Théâtre
programme.desc: Born in the United States, Madeleine Peyroux is a jazz singer and guitarist with an unclassifiable style and an exceptional artistic personality, carried by a voice that is both soft and husky, with blues and folk accents. After spending part of her childhood in the United States, she moved to France as a teenager where she joined her first jazz bands. An atypical artist, she performs a lot in the street while participating in festivals and creating her own albums. In 2004, she had an international success with Careless Love. Other albums have been released since, including the recent Anthem (2018), the title of which is taken from a Leonard Cohen song.

programme.title: ¡Repítelo! En busca de bucles
programme.desc: This one-hour documentary sets out in search of the phenomena of repetition in music history: from the Middle Ages to minimal music, from the motets of Josquin des Prés to Maurice Ravel's Bolero and pop music, from Handel to the hand-made loops of Mike Oldfield, from loop pioneer Terry Riley to live looper Konrad Küchenmeister, from George Antheil to Balinese gamelan music. “Play it again!” not only investigates the causes, but also the effects: What is repetition, what is variation and what is a loop? What is actually being repeated’? Does repetition have feel-good or rather anger potential? Music ethnologists, neuroscientists, composers and performers search for answers to these questions. Using selected works as a spotlight, the aggregate states of repetition are traced and, above all, listened to. Concert scenes alternate with dance scenes in which repetition sets the beat, supplemented by world music archive material.The eternal return of the same becomes a stylistic device in itself. The narrative strands are mostly cyclical: Short stories about repetitive routines become loops and playful cartoons tell humorous never-ending stories. Loop collages run through the film like a rondo, associatively taking into account non-musical manifestations of the endless loop.Subtitles available for this program with your remote control.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Art quiz
programme.desc: Test and develop your artistic culture with Art Quiz, the game that will allow you to become unaware of art. Whether it's artists, works of art, artistic trends, the price of works... nothing will be a secret for you anymore. Now it's your turn to play!

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Charlety, a stadium in the city
programme.desc: Découvrez un bâtiment de l’architecture classique, moderne ou contemporaine avec une « leçons d’architecture » conjuguant rigueur, plaisir et intelligence. Au stade Charlety, les architectes ont réussi à concilier les contraires : la grandeur monumentale du stade avec celle du quartier, la vie d’une cité sportive avec celle des bureaux. Situé à la porte de Gentilly à Paris, coincé entre le périphérique et le boulevard des Maréchaux, le stade Charléty est bordé des pavillons de la Cité universitaire, d’un cimetière et de HLM en briques rouges. Sur ce site difficile de huit hectares, marqué par les cinquante ans d’histoire de l’ancien stade Sébastien-Charléty, Henri Gaudin et son fils Bruno ont su implanter le volume massif d’un stade de 20 000 places couvertes, ainsi que les équipements sportifs et les bureaux commandés par la Ville de Paris. En concevant ce grand stade avec sa forme d’anneau gigantesque, ses gradins en ellipse et sa toiture aérienne, les architectes ont su traduire l’é.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Located near Compiègne, Château de Pierrefonds was one of Jean de Berry's most powerful châteaux, dismantled and gutted by order of Richelieu in the 17th century, and one of the most beautiful medieval ruins to inspire so much romantic nostalgia in the 19th century. A ruin bought by Napoleon III, who wished to transform it into an imperial residence...

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The 5 Masterpieces of the Museum of Modern Art – Paris
programme.desc: In 2010, five masterpieces by Picasso, Matisse, Braque, Modigliani and Léger went missing. A year into the investigation, the police arrested the burglar, Vrejan Tomic. A repeat offender, with 11 art thefts to his name, he usually works to order. In this case, the client was Jean-Michel Corvez. Wrapped in bin bags, these unsellable works were found at the home of a third man, Yonathan Birn. How? Why?

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Looting of the Gentili Di Giuseppe Collection
programme.desc: Federico Gentili di Giuseppe was a Jewish businessman of Italian origin with a passion for art. On his death in 1940, he bequeathed a collection of 150 paintings to his two children, Marcel and Adriana, who had become naturalised French citizens. In 1941, Maître Moulin auctioned off these paintings under questionable circumstances. This marked the beginning of a legal battle waged by the Gentili di Giuseppe heirs, which was to last nearly 50 years.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Discover or rediscover the masterpieces of the Dutch national museum Rijksmuseum with artists such as Rembrandt, Vermeer...

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: This eagerly-awaited exhibition at the Royal Academy of Arts was the first-ever retrospective devoted to the portraiture of Édouard Manet. Covering the entire career of this enigmatic and sometimes controversial artist, the exhibition brought together works from Europe, Asia and the United States. Manet's portraiture has never been the subject of an exhibition, although it represents around half of his artistic output. He painted his family, friends and the literary, political and artistic figures of the day, bringing to life not only his subjects but also Parisian society.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: In 2013, Norway celebrated the 150th anniversary of the birth of Edvard Munch (1863-1944), one of the most prominent figures in modern art. Munch 150, co-produced by the National Museum and the Munch Museum, is already being hailed as "the exhibition of a lifetime". Public interest is enormous, as evidenced by the record-breaking $120 million public auction result for one of his four paintings, The Scream. This presentation will take you behind the scenes of how this exhibition came to be, as well as including a guided tour of Norway, outlining the biography of this man whose life spanned the mid-19th century to the German occupation during the Second World War.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: John Singer Sargent: Fashion and Swagger
programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Two luvvies from the world of stage and TV, Ruth Madoc and Su Pollard, best known for their appearances in sitcom Hi-De-Hi, are antique hunting with Phil Serrell and Raj Bisram. Setting off from the Welsh border town of Monmouth they head for auction in Congleton, Cheshire. Ruth also gets to find out about the incredible 19th century nurse – and it’s not Florence Nightingale – whilst Su visits ancient Roman town Caerleon and finds time for an amphitheatre showdown with Phil. And Su attempts to resolve an age old mystery...does Phil wear a wig?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

Tony squeezes in a visit to Coalbrookdale, the place where ground breaking techniques were developed that kick-started the industrial revolution. And petrol-head Jimmy gets to whizz round the historical race circuit at Donington. The big auction finale includes a sing-a-long like no other. But which musical maestro will clinch victory?

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted in 1911, Pablo Picasso’s "La Coiffeuse" is an iconic work of Cubism. The painting was last seen in 1998, following a loan for an exhibition in Munich. On its return to Paris, it was stored in the Centre Pompidou’s storerooms… until the day it was discovered to be missing, in 2001. Had it been stolen from the storerooms? Sixteen years after the theft, in 2014, a ship docked at the port of Newark, in New Jersey, USA. The artwork was on board….

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Claude Monet is probably the best-known painter of the impressionist movement. Indeed, the term “impressionism” was derived from his painting “Impression Rising Sun” (1872). This exhibition retraces the great stages in Monet’s prolific career while dwelling on paintings of this master that cannot be ignored: the “Saint Lazare Station”, the “Poppies near Argenteuil”, the “Haystacks” and the “Rouen Cathedral” exposed all around the world in different museum such as the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston without forgetting his “Water-lilies” exposed at the Orangerie museum in Paris. Enjoy your visit!

programme.desc: John Singer Sargent is known as the greatest portrait artist of his era. What made his ‘swagger’ portraits remarkable was his power over his sitters, what they wore and how they were presented to the audience. Through interviews with curators, contemporary fashionistas and style influencers, Exhibition on Screen’s film will examine how Sargent’s unique practice has influenced modern art, culture and fashion.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: Discover some of the works of Georges Seurat realized during the end of the 19th century. These works are exhibited in Paris, Troyes or London.

programme.title: Art quiz
programme.desc: Test and develop your artistic culture with Art Quiz, the game that will allow you to become unaware of art. Whether it's artists, works of art, artistic trends, the price of works... nothing will be a secret for you anymore. Now it's your turn to play!

programme.title: My little Museum
programme.desc: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: Le familistère de Guise, une cité radieuse
programme.desc: André Godin, inspired by Charles Fourier's phalanstères, envisioned a palatial communal living space for his workers. From 1860 to 1968, the Guise Familistère, a community built for 1800 inhabitants by the great Fourierist industrialist Jean-Baptiste-André Godin (1817-1889), served as the stage for a social experiment that remained unique in its audacity, scale, and duration. The invention of a "unitary" architecture and urban planning is one of the original and pioneering aspects of the Familistère adventure. This "Social Palace" constituted a true utopia in action, which today once again arouses the interest of historians, sociologists, economists, urban planners, and architects.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: The irresistible building of the Musée de Picardie
programme.desc: The Musée de Picardie in Amiens is a prototype. It is the first museum built as such in France. But its construction was not easy. The Museum was initially intended to be a "Petit Louvre

programme.title: Completely Gouzou
programme.desc: Gouzous are small anthropomorphic characters that frequently appear as collages or more often as graffiti in the urban space of Reunion Island, but also in other countries. The author is the French graffiti artist Jace, originally from Le Havre, who lives and works in La Réunion.

programme.title: Raw Art: When one looks, one finds it!
programme.desc: This documentary travels to France to question the contours of Raw Art. Savine Faupin, curator of the department Art Brut at LAM, Matthew Morin, connoisseur and collector Christian Berst, owner of the eponymous gallery: each character tries to put his own definition of an art difficult to grasp. Indeed, Raw Art is constantly renewing itself, it is not limited by time or by the style and remains foremost vector emotional message.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Vermeer and Music - The Art of Love and Leisure
programme.desc: The National Gallery of London is offering a fresh look at arguably one of the greatest artists of all – Johannes Vermeer, painter of the famous Girl with a Pearl Earring. In an exhibition entitled ‘Vermeer and Music: The Art of Love and Leisure’, The National Gallery has chosen to focus on Vermeer’s relationship with music. It is one of the most popular themes of Dutch painting and reveals an enormous amount about this most fascinating of artists.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Kiss by Gustav Klimt is one of the most recognised and reproduced paintings in the world. It is perhaps the most popular poster on student dorm walls from Beijing to Boston. Painted in Vienna around 1908, the evocative image of an unknown embracing couple has captivated viewers with its mystery, sensuality and dazzling materials ever since it was created. But just what lies behind the appeal of the painting – and just who was the artist that created it? Delving into the details of real gold, decorative designs, symbolism and simmering erotica, a close study of the painting takes us to the remarkable turn of the century Vienna when a new world was battling with the old.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Legends of stage and screen, Charles Dance and Geraldine James join antiques experts Natasha Raskin and Will Axon on this Road Trip romp around Wiltshire. Charles finds a pair of Edwardian silver vases he hopes will prove profitable at an auction in Essex. Geraldine, however, bumps into a chap in the street with a 19th Century French Empire secretaire. It costs her a small fortune – will the gamble pay off? A diversion from the shops sees Charles end up in the cockpit of a very old helicopter while Geraldine learns how a small part of Swindon dating back 170 years influenced the creation of the modern NHS.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: On this July 14, 1906, day of the French national day, the tricolored flags float in the streets of Le Havre. Discover sumptuous works with landscapes of all kinds.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: In 2013, Norway celebrated the 150th anniversary of the birth of Edvard Munch (1863-1944), one of the most prominent figures in modern art. Munch 150, co-produced by the National Museum and the Munch Museum, is already being hailed as "the exhibition of a lifetime". Public interest is enormous, as evidenced by the record-breaking $120 million public auction result for one of his four paintings, The Scream. This presentation will take you behind the scenes of how this exhibition came to be, as well as including a guided tour of Norway, outlining the biography of this man whose life spanned the mid-19th century to the German occupation during the Second World War.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso is one of the world's greatest artists, and until his death in 1973, he was its most prolific. How did it all begin? After being ignored for too long, it's time to focus on the artist's early years and the upbringing that enabled him to achieve the extraordinary. Three cities played a key role: Malaga, Barcelona and Paris. Young Picasso traverses them and explores their influence on the artist, analyzing specific works from his early years.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Matisse au MoMA et à la Tate Modern
programme.desc: Discover the work of Matisse through the exhibitions at Tate Modern in London and MoMA in New York (2014) and enjoy the original performance of Royal Ballet star dancer Zenaida Yanowsky, who interprets the colors and dynamism of Matisse's painting to the jazz music of Courtney Pine. Punctuated by interviews with experts and rare archival footage of Matisse at work, this documentary will provide a special insight into the last chapter of the painter's career.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Léonard à la National Gallery de Londres
programme.desc: A remarkable event occurred at London’s National Gallery when the largest ever collection of Leonardo’s surviving paintings was assembled in a unique exhibition: Leonardo da Vinci: Painter at the Court of Milan. Leonardo is recognised as perhaps the greatest painter and sculptor of all time but there was no end to his talents. This film tells his life story and expands on Leonardo the visionary and inventor from the place where he lived out his final years at Château du Clos Lucé in France, concluding that Leonardo da Vinci was perhaps the very embodiment of the spirit of the Renaissance.

programme.title: Graffiti World
programme.desc: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Vocal coaches and husband and wife David and Carrie Grant are swapping singing in harmony for battling it out with antiques. With the help of experts Will Axon and Mark Stacey our competitive celebrity couple uncover some unusual items to sell at auction in rural Norfolk.David also visits a patch of inner-city grass in Cambridge where today children play and dogs are walked but was actually the birthplace of football, while Carrie learns how Letchworth Garden City sparked a revolution in town design.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.What led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: Where do we start when we want to talk about such a famous painting as Velázquez “Las Meninas”? There is an incredibly huge bibliography on this painting, to the point that it is almost utopian to think or hope we can document ourselves on everything in and about it... From the late 1800s to the early 2000s, dozens of books have come out all over the world specifically and solely devoted to this one, single painting. A parallel literary current has even developed around the “enigmas” and “mysteries” connected with “Las Meninas”.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The story of “The Calling of Saint Matthew” begins on a hot summer day in Rome in 1600, the Jubilee Year. The entire Eternal City is a construction site: streets are full of scaffolding, dust clouds, loose cobblestones, the continuous banging of hammers and rasping of saws, carpenters with Lombard accents, errand boys shouting across the streets in Roman dialect, stevedores unloading barrels and crates from boats along the Tiber. The narrow streets in the town center are full of jostling tourists and monsignors rushing to get somewhere, and every once in a while the crowd parts to let a sedan chair or carriage of a cardinal through. Convent bells ring, droves of pilgrims mass along the routes connecting the old basilicas, reciting the rosary as they go. Not a day goes by without the opening of a new church, an oratory, or a chapel. Fascinated by this hubbub, dozens of artists from every nation roam the classical ruins and new palaces in the heat and dust (!) drawing everything they see.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: For almost 500 years, a large painting showing two young women at a fountain has been seen as an absolute hymn to beauty and love, executed by the young Titian who had set out to conquer the Venetian art scene. It is a solemn, luminous song, looking onto a bright, harmonious universe; it is the first true masterpiece of the twenty-five-year-old painter who knowingly started revolutionizing the history of painting. As one of his contemporaries said, Titian “walks hand in hand with nature; all of his figures are alive, move, and their flesh quivers.” After changing hands several times among different Venetian collections, it was finally purchased by Cardinal Scipione Borghese in 1608 for the Roman collection to which it still belongs today. The painting soon lost all ties with the person who commissioned it, and came to be understood as a broad, universal allegory of love, of two possible forms of love; the “sacred” and the “profane”.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.sub-title: Bosch, The Garden Of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: The Garden Of Earthly Delights: how did this five-panel triptych by Jeroen Anthoniszoon van Aken, known as Hieronymus Bosch, come to be created, when was it painted, what was it used for, and what does it really represent? No one knows; for most of bosch’s works no documents or precise information about buyers exist. even the dating itself is complicated. Historians, archivists, and art critics have tried everything. A veil of mystery envelops his entire artistic production, giving rise to the most varied rumours but for now searching for clues in the local traditions, in the writings in latin, french, german and dutch, searching for possible iconographic precedents and parallels, peering into the murky mirror of magical rites and heresies, delving into alchemy treatises, and pulling out from the fog of history figures who had practically been forgotten. The search goes on, but for the time being we have no first-hand information. For almost all of bosch’s works, no conclusive docu.

programme.title: Masterpieces Unveiled
programme.desc: The image of the wealthy merchant from Lucca Giovanni Arnolfini shown together with his wife in the intimacy of their comfortable home in Bruges has always been considered the brilliant figurative proof of the commercial and artistic relations between Italy and Flanders in the 15th century. However, there has been a certain amount of doubtful attention devoted to the figures for some time; in fact, the hypothesis that one of the maximum masterpieces of portraiture of all times may not depict the Arnolfinis at all, but the van Eycks, is not entirely new. It had already been cautiously suggested by the Director of London’s National Gallery over a century and a half ago, when the painting was purchased by the great museum, but the idea was soon cast aside by the objections of specialists. Other doubts about the couple’s identity have cropped up a number of times, juggled back and forth amongst the abundant historic information on the painting, archival research, and allegorical theori.

programme.title: Private Tour
programme.sub-title: A landscape of excellence, three figures of French architecture
programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "A landscape of excellence, three figures of French architecture" at the Cité de l'Architecture & du Patrimoine in Paris. This exhibition offers a journey through contemporary creation. Since the 90s, three figures of French architecture have marked the history of art, Frédéric Borel, Marc Barani and Jean-Marc Ibos and Myrto Vitart. They have shown the excellence of French creations in the world.

programme.title: Within The Frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Between 1870 and 1914, the Menier factory in Noisiel was the largest chocolate factory in the world. But it was also, and above all, a pioneering factory in terms of architectural innovation. Its iron and then concrete architecture symbolized the company's power and modernity. Its three major buildings - the Saulnier Mill, the world's first all-steel structure, the Eiffel Hall and the Cathedral - tell the story of the golden age of industrial architecture.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will go to the Rodin Museum. This museum, built in 1930, displays many plaster casts, including those of Rodin's monumental works in their successive states : The Gate of Hell, The Burghers of Calais, the many studies and figures of Balzac, the monuments to Victor Hugo...

programme.title: An hour with...
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Franco-Danish painter, Camille Pissarro. You will discover his labour with View from Louveciennes, A path through the fields, Pontoise or Peasant girl making a fire.

programme.title: An hour with...
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Prussian painter, Caspar David Friedrich. You will discover his labour with The Wanderer above the mists, Greifswald port or the Lone tree.

programme.desc: Learn to stay open, no matter what happens, with the Root to Rise sequence. This practice provides an opportunity to explore your capacity for receiving energy, while building strength and confidence. When you maintain a connection to grounded energy, you can heighten your ability to stay present in every moment.

programme.title: Home training
programme.desc: This episode of "Home Training" offers a session dedicated to lower body strengthening, specially designed by Guillaume. Participants are guided through a careful warm-up, essential to prepare the joints and avoid injury. The session focuses on the legs and glutes with varied and progressive exercises that also boost the cardio. Guillaume and Sabrina encourage maintaining an upright posture for effective and safe training. This program, both intense and motivating, is perfect for toning the lower body while having fun.
